name: Arjun Chaturvedi
summary:
A results-oriented retail professional with over 20 years of progressive experience in premium and luxury lifestyle
brands. Having built a career from the ground up — across store operations, regional management, national
expansion, and strategic consulting — the focus has consistently been on building businesses that are commercially
sound and operationally disciplined. Strong command of both online and offline retail environments, with hands-on
expertise in driving topline revenue, protecting margins, and establishing the systems and teams needed for
sustainable scale. Known for taking ownership of outcomes, bringing structure to growth, and getting the best out of
the people and businesses worked with.
EDUCATION: 2. BMS — Welingkar Institute of Management (2003 - 2006) [conf 0.95, review=False]

responsibilities: Engaged as a strategic and operational advisor to premium lifestyle brands at varying stages of growth, with a particular focus on building the commercial and organisational foundations needed for scalable expansion.
Developed detailed business plans and product-to-market roadmaps for a premium wellness brand (MyMatsya), covering competitive positioning, distribution strategy, and a phased D2C growth plan.

Designed a comprehensive sales management framework for a premium interiors and home décor brand (Mantra One & Mira Living) to support aggressive growth targets — including sales team structure, KPI architecture, and performance review cadence.
Architected end-to-end SOPs for sales operations and inventory management, resulting in a meaningful reduction in operational costs and a measurable improvement in stock visibility.
Formulated go-to-market and distribution strategies for domestic footprint expansion into previously untapped regions, including channel identification, partner onboarding, and launch support.
Developed franchise and market entry models tailored for Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, enabling asset-light expansion with lower capital requirements and replicable operating standards.
Established D2C revenue infrastructure through integrated online sales and digital marketing strategies, creating incremental revenue streams alongside existing offline channels.
Led recruitment, structured training, and performance management programmes to build sales and operations teams aligned with brand positioning and commercial targets.
Led domestic retail expansion and brand development for a premium furniture label, with ownership across franchise development, company-owned operations, and D2C growth.
Formulated and drove execution of a national expansion roadmap through a hybrid model of company-owned outlets and franchise partnerships, balancing capital efficiency with brand integrity.
Co-led merchandising and inventory planning functions to align product assortment with regional consumer preferences — a critical lever for managing high-value furniture inventory profitably.
Built and managed cross-functional teams across sales and HR, ensuring talent pipelines were aligned with the pace and demands of expansion.
Established operational frameworks and vendor partnerships that enabled scalable growth while protecting margins and sustaining service quality.

Held full ownership of national business development and retail operations for one of India’s most respected premium brands, with P&L responsibility across the store network and a direct mandate to grow the brand’s physical presence in key markets.

Successfully identified, negotiated, and signed 5 new premium retail locations within 12 months — spanning Mumbai, Delhi, Raipur, Kolkata, and Pune — directly contributing to national market share growth.
Managed end-to-end retail operations with accountability for P&L performance, project execution, recruitment, and customer experience delivery.
Applied rigorous location strategy and build-out cost controls to improve store-level economics and accelerate return on investment for new openings.
Established and embedded a ‘White Glove’ service culture across EBOs and partner outlets, driving measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and repeat clientele.
Standardised operations through comprehensive SOPs rolled out across the entire retail network, ensuring brand consistency and reducing operational variability.
a multi-city, multi-format store network and driving consistent commercial performance in a competitive premium fashion segment.

Delivered end-to-end retail operations across 20 stores and shop-in-shops across 14 cities — spanning EBO, MBO, and online formats — with direct accountability for sales performance, visual merchandising, inventory health, and team output.
Represented the India business at global buying sessions in the USA and Milan, contributing to seasonal product selection, trend analysis, and strategic reviews with international brand leadership.
Conceptualised and scaled the ‘Home Shopping’ revenue model, generating the equivalent of a full store’s revenue at below 50% of the operating cost — subsequently adopted as a company-wide strategy.

Drove data-led retail performance improvement — consistently achieving and exceeding sales targets through disciplined inventory management, sell-through optimisation, and customer engagement programmes.
Built and mentored retail teams across the country, establishing service and operational benchmarks that consistently elevated brand standing in the luxury fashion segment.

Managed P&L and commercial performance for a portfolio of ultra-premium and luxury fashion brands across the North region over seven years — building a strong foundation in high-ticket retail, multi-brand management, and international brand stewardship.
Drove consistent revenue growth and market leadership across the regional portfolio, with accountability for store P&Ls, area manager performance, and key customer relationships.

Conceptualised and launched multiple flagship stores in marquee luxury retail destinations including DLF Emporio, Vasant Kunj, demonstrating expertise in luxury store formats and premium real estate strategy.
Travelled to the USA and Milan for seasonal buying, product curation, and strategic business reviews — bringing global brand perspectives and market intelligence back to the India operations.
Piloted the ‘Home Shopping’ concept as an alternate revenue model — generating store-equivalent revenue at 50% lower overhead — which was subsequently adopted across the broader retail portfolio.
Applied RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis to manage high-net-worth client retention and maximise lifetime value across premium brand touchpoints.
Led and developed area and store managers through structured coaching programmes, building a strong regional team culture rooted in service excellence and commercial accountability.
